overview.title: Dhaka's Premier Chef Training Academy
overview.text:
Choosing the right cooking school is the most important decision for your career. Dhaka hosts several training centers, but the difference lies in the fidelity of training. CIB is recognized as the best culinary institute in Dhaka because we prioritize hands-on practice, industrial kitchen hygiene, and 5-star executive chef mentorship over plain classroom lectures.

Our campus features a 2,000 sq. ft. commercial-grade kitchen equipped with professional ovens and high-pressure burners. This allows students to practice in the exact environment they will encounter in 5-star hotels globally.

table.heading: Why CIB Ranks as Dhaka's Best Culinary Institute

faqs.question: Why is CIB considered the best culinary institute in Dhaka?
faqs.answer: CIB stands out due to its 2,000 sq. ft. commercial lab, instruction under Executive Chefs, NSDA accreditation, and verified 5-star hotel internship placements.

faqs.question: Can I visit the CIB campus to compare?
faqs.answer: Yes. We encourage prospective students to visit our campus at House-160, Lake Circus, Kalabagan, Dhanmondi, to compare our commercial setup with other schools.

faqs.question: What is the student placement rate at CIB?
faqs.answer: CIB maintains a 95% placement rate, with graduates working as Commis and Pastry Chefs in top hotels across Bangladesh, the Gulf, and Europe.
